description: This source file defines a security policy enumeration in Swift, which contains sets of environment variable keys and prefixes that are blocked or restricted for security reasons, likely used to enforce environment variable security constraints within an application.

classes.name: HostEnvSecurityPolicy
classes.description: An enumeration that encapsulates sets of environment variable keys and prefixes that are blocked or restricted to enforce security policies.

methods.name: blockedKeys
methods.description: A static set of environment variable names that are explicitly blocked from being set or used.

methods.name: blockedOverrideKeys
methods.description: A static set of environment variable names that are sometimes allowed to override other restrictions.

methods.name: blockedOverridePrefixes
methods.description: A list of prefixes for environment variables that are blocked from being set if they start with these prefixes.

methods.name: blockedPrefixes
methods.description: A list of prefixes for environment variables that are completely blocked.
